    Args:
        x: A numpy array representing observations of current position.
        v: A numpy array representing observations of velocity.

    damping = params[0]  # Fractional damping parameter (0 < damping < 1)

    k_linear = params[2]  # Linear stiffness
    driving_force = params[3]  # Amplitude of driving force
